judgments.rationale: The proposed summary asserts that the centralized source requirement applies to every agency described in section 1681a(p) or (w). However, source passage F006 explicitly restricts the centralized source condition to consumer reporting agencies described in section 1681a(p). Agencies described in section 1681a(w) are nationwide specialty consumer reporting agencies governed by subparagraph (C) (F011), which requires a streamlined process including a toll-free telephone number rather than the centralized source established under section 211(c).

The baseline claim C0000 accurately represents subparagraph (A) (F002, F004). Subparagraph (B) (F006) is already tracked as an independent requirement in draft claim C0001. Rather than establishing a structured qualification relationship, the proposed edit improperly embeds the substantive condition of subparagraph (B) directly into C0000's summary and context quotes, creating an unneeded paraphrase duplicate of C0001 and failing to fix a genuine defect in C0000.
